versions.changelog:
re-blog-meta v1.1.4

- Added a new rule to the Quality bar: do not use AI hype adjectives (e.g., "comprehensive", "ultimate", "revolutionary") in titles or descriptions.
- Updated references/meta-output.md and SKILL.md to clarify and enforce this rule.
- Added references/human-voice.md to provide guidance on writing in a natural, non-hyped style.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No other changes to workflow, features, or documentation.
No user-visible changes in this version; no file changes detected.

- Updated browser startup instructions to require using the command openclaw browser start for opening the managed browser.
- Clarified that only the specified command should be used to open the browser, not any alternatives.
- Emphasized this step as CRITICAL NON-NEGOTIABLE in the workflow documentation.

No functional or documentation changes detected in this version.

- Version 1.1.0 does not include any file modifications or updates.

- No changes detected in this version.
- Functionality, workflow, and requirements remain the same as the previous release.

No user-facing changes in this version.

- Version 1.0.8 contains no file or documentation updates.
- No new features, bug fixes, or workflow changes detected.

No major changes in workflow or features. Internal documentation improvement.

- Expanded content in references/meta-output.md for more detailed instructions or clarification.
- No changes to the skill logic or user workflow.
- No impact on user-facing functionality.

- Clarified skill purpose and usage for generating complete SEO metadata for a single blog post per run.
- Added explicit research workflow: mandates use of browser (Google, Google Trends, Reddit, X/Twitter) before generating any meta fields.
- Established strict quality requirements: field length limits, unique display/SEO titles, slug format, and SEO description rules.
- Specified file handling: reads from ~/blogs, saves JSON to ~/blog-meta using the generated SEO slug, and details error handling if the blog file is missing.
- Outlined completion report requirements to improve transparency and reproducibility.
